                        # current insertion edges prev2-nxt2 will be replaced by prev2-node-node-nxt2
                        cur_ins_edge = matrix[prev2][nxt2] if (ins_pos < len(rj)) or True else 0
                        # If rj empty, prev2=depot and nxt2=depot, and cur_ins_edge = depot->depot = 0
                        if not rj:
                            cur_ins_edge = matrix[depot][depot]  # likely 0
                        new_ins = matrix[prev2][node] + matrix[node][nxt2]
                        delta = (new_ins - cur_ins_edge) - cur_best_keep
                        # also account that node removal splits/joins edges in ri; removal delta already computed
                        # total delta is new insertion minus old insertion edge - old removal edges
                        # cur_remove is exactly old edges replaced by prev-nxt after removal
                        # so delta formula above is correct
                        if best_global is None or delta < best_global[0]:
                            best_global = (delta, i, pos, j, ins_pos)
        if best_global is None:
            return False
        if best_global[0] >= 0:
            return False
        _, i, pos, j, ins_pos = best_global

        node = routes[i][pos]
        # remove from i
        routes[i].pop(pos)
        # insert into j
        routes[j].insert(ins_pos, node)
        # optionally drop empty routes
        if not routes[i]:
            routes.pop(i)
        return True

    # run limited number of relocate improvements
    for _ in range(30):
        if not inter_relocate(routes):
            break

    # final cleanup: remove empty routes (just in case)
    routes = [r for r in routes if r]

    return routes
